children: UK automotive electrical connector maker's H1 2026 revenue grew 18% yr/yr
Adjusted EBITDA loss for H1 2026 narrowed by 49% yr/yr
Company received £3.0 mln DRIVE35 grant to support manufacturing scale-up
Company expects performance to strengthen in H2 2026 as production volumes ramp up
Company says automotive sector remains challenging due to tariffs and geopolitical uncertainty
PROGRAMME LAUNCHES - Revenue growth attributed to successful launch and ramp-up of three major programmes, including battery and smart-glass products
BATTERY TECHNOLOGIES - Battery Technologies revenue rose 62% yr/yr, driven by Cell Contacting System programme ramp-up and electrification investment
MARGIN PRESSURE - Gross margin declined due to increased outsourcing costs and lower proportion of pre-serial prototype sales; management expects margin improvement as production scales
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the electrical components & equipment peer group is "buy"
